notes.actors: Character slots use robot n of the roster for _r<n>: human _r0, ruby _r1, lime _r2, gold _r3, violet _r4, slate _r5, mint _r6, snow _r7. Rides use the player robot (_r0).
notes.frames: frames: "all" (evenly sampled to max_frames), an integer count, or a list of 1-based frame numbers.
notes.sources: sprite/rows name an exported class, or #<character id> for unnamed symbols. null means the SWF has no matching source.
